mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (below 6%) creates a 'goldilocks' zone, boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of 'goldilocks' zone instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, leads to decreased S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to anticipated supply chain disruptions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining INDPRO periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating a surge in housing demand, S&P 500 forward returns increase over the next 60 trading days due to the positive wealth effect.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with HOUST above its 6mo MA, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (below 1%) and rising CPIAUCSL (above 2% YoY) creates an inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of inflationary environment instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE below 5% for 3 consecutive months, indicating a very tight labor market, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances with sustained low UNRATE, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between increasing RSAFS (indicating rising retail sales) and high GDPC1 (above $14T) creates a consumption-driven growth environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of consumption-driven growth environment instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
